decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period)
fact: Car 10 collided with Car 55 in Turn 4
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 55 attempted an overtake on the outside on Car 10 into Turn 4. Car 55 had its front axle ahead of the front axle of Car 10 at the apex and therefore had the right to the racing line according to the Driving Standard Guidelines. Car 10 tried to retake the position but thereby collided with Car 55. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 10 is wholly at fault and impose the standard penalty for such incidents.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 10 Colliding With Car 55
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
